meta.title: MartGo System: mart-api + martgo-auth
meta.subtitle: nginx gateway splits /api/v1 between the store API and the auth service; they share only Redis session state and an Ed25519 key pair

cards.title: Gateway routing
items: nginx sends /api/v1/auth/ and /api/v1/users to :8081, everything else to :8080
Both Go services run on the host; nginx, Redis and Postgres run in Docker

cards.title: Token trust
items: martgo-auth signs EdDSA JWTs (iss martgo-auth, claims uid/role/ver)
mart-api only holds the public key, so it cannot mint tokens
Each request reads session:user:{id} from Redis and fails closed if Redis is down
A token is rejected if ver differs or the account is inactive; role comes from Redis

cards.title: Login flow
items: Password check with in-memory lockout: 5 fails → 15 min, per instance
Users with a phone get an OTP stored in Redis and sent via Telbiz (or logged when SMS_PROVIDER=log, blocked in production)
Token issue and logout write the session to Redis; logout bumps token_version

cards.title: Data ownership
items: Each service has its own Postgres; neither reads the other's database
mart-api: categories, suppliers, products, sales, purchases, stock movements
martgo-auth: users (password hash, phone, role, token_version)
